detail: VVD came first with 33 seats. D66 then joined the third Rutte cabinet; Jetten took his seat on 23 March 2017.

role_sought: Member of the House of Representatives, no. 2 on the D66 list behind Sigrid Kaag
result: Elected; D66 won 24 seats, second place
detail: Polling ran from 15 to 17 March 2021. VVD came first with 34 seats; D66 joined the fourth Rutte cabinet, in which Jetten became a minister in January 2022.

opponent: Geert Wilders (PVV), Frans Timmermans (GL-PvdA), Dilan Yeşilgöz (VVD), Pieter Omtzigt (NSC)
detail: The PVV came first with 37 seats; D66 went into opposition to the Schoof cabinet.

role_sought: Member of the House of Representatives, D66 lead candidate (lijsttrekker)
result: Elected; D66 largest party by votes with 26 seats, tied in seats with the PVV
detail: D66's best result in a general election, under the slogan 'Het kan wél'. Official result established by the Kiesraad on 7 November 2025, with a margin of 29,668 votes over the PVV; VVD 22 seats, GL-PvdA 20, CDA 18. Turnout 78.3%. The election led to the D66–VVD–CDA minority cabinet with Jetten as prime minister.
